description: For a deductively closed propositional theory, completeness and consistency are equivalent to maximal consistency among deductively closed theories.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.complete_iff_maximal.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (_hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsComplete T ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsMaximalConsistent T
